94	_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
100	# hashes the corpus the same way.
101	_sm_sha256() {
102	  python3 -I -c '
103	import hashlib, sys
104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
107	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
108	            h.update(b)
109	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
110	}

112	# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
113	_sm_evidence() {
114	  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
115	  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
116	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
117	  else
118	    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
119	    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
120	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
121	  fi
122	}

161	resolve_arm_toggles() {
162	  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
163	  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
164	  local found=0 entry=""
165	  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
166	    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
167	    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
168	      || entry=""
169	    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
170	  fi
171	  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
172	    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
173	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
174	    return 2
175	  fi
176	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
177	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
178	    return 2
179	  fi
180	  local t
181	  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
182	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
183	  printf '%s' "$t"

187	# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
188	# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
189	_sm_drop_md_section() {
190	  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
191	  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
192	  awk -v h="$heading" '
193	    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
194	    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
195	    skip { n++; next }
196	    { print }
197	    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
198	  mv "$tmp" "$f"
199	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
200	}

202	# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
203	# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
204	# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
205	_sm_drop_paragraph() {
206	  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
207	import re, sys
208	path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
209	text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
210	paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
211	for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
212	    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
213	        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
214	            removed = paras[i]
215	            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
216	            del paras[i:i + 2]
217	            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
218	            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
219	            sys.exit(0)
220	sys.exit(1)
221	PY
222	}

224	# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
225	# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
226	_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
227	  local f="$1" tmp
228	  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
229	  awk '
230	    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
231	    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
232	    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
233	    { print }
234	    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
235	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
236	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
237	}

242	}

255	apply_arm_toggles() {
256	  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
257	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
258	  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'

287	            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
288	          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
289	          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
290	          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
291	        fi
292	        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
293	        ;;
294	      rule_files)
295	        local r gone=""
296	        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
297	          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
298	          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
299	        done
300	        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
301	        ;;
302	      audit_delta_instruction)
303	        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
304	        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }

308	        ;;
309	      loa_mount)
310	        local p left=""
311	        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
312	          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
313	        done
314	        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
315	        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
316	        ;;

319	        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do

322	          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
323	          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi

325	        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
326	        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
327	        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
328	          local nkeys
329	          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
330	          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \

332	          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
333	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }

335	          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
336	          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }

338	          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then

349	        ;;

352	          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }

355	        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
356	        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
357	        ;;

376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
377	  local ws="$1"
378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
381	    return 0
382	  fi
383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
388	  else
389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
394	    : > "$sums"
395	    local -a batch=()
396	    local f
397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
398	      batch+=("$f")
399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
401	        batch=()
402	      fi
403	    done < "$list"
404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
406	    fi
407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
413	  fi
414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
415	  local digest
416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
419	  return 0
420	}

483	      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
484	    } > "$g/sprint.md"

488	      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
489	      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
4	#
5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
23	#
24	# Usage:
25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
29	#
30	# Options:
31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
34	#                       alias --workspace
35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
36	#   --trial N           trial number
37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
47	#
48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
58	#
59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
88	#
89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
95	#
96	# Exit codes:
97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
98	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
99	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
100	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
101	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
102	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
103	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
106	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
107	#
108	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
109	# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
110	# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
111	#
112	# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
113	# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
114	#
115	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
116	# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
117	# =============================================================================
118	set -euo pipefail

129	MAX_RUN_USD="" EXECUTOR="${LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR:-container}" IMAGE="loa-ablation:258"
130	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"

168	[[ -z "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-models must be a JSON object"
169	[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
170	[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'

174	TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
175	SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

177

180

182	  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
183	  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"

579	  local m="$1" hit alias j
580	  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"

585	    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
586	    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \

590	  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
591	              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
592	                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
593	                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}

598	# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
599	price_events() {
600	  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
601	    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
602	                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
603	    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
604	                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
605	      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
606	       .n += 1
607	       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
608	       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
609	       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
610	    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
611	    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
612	         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
613	    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
614	}

838	     duration_ms: ($result.duration_ms // $dur), wall_ms: $dur,
839	     num_turns: ($result.num_turns // $est_turns), max_turns: $turns, timeout_s: $tsec,
840	     exit: $rc, cli_exit: $cli_exit, timed_out: $timed_out, is_error: (($result.is_error // false) or ($rc != 0)),
841	     result_subtype: ($result.subtype // null), turn_cap_hit: $turn_cap_hit, gate_recovered: $gate_recovered,
842	     refusal_fallbacks: $rf,
843	     modelinv_lines: {from: $minv_from, to: $minv_to},
844	     ledger_lines_from: $ledger_from,
845	     snapshot: (if $snap == "" then null else $snap end),
846	     verdict: (if $verdict == "null" or $verdict == "" then null else $verdict end),
847	     watchdog: {priced: ($priced != "null"), estimate_usd: ($est_micro / 1000000), turns_seen: $est_turns,
848	                killed: ($killed == 1), cap_turn: (if $killed == 1 then $cap_turn else null end)},
849	     started: $started, finished: $finished}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"
850	
851	  # --- account and decide ---
852	  local cost_micro
853	  cost_micro="$(jq -r --argjson e "${est_micro:-0}" '(.total_cost_usd // ($e / 1000000)) * 1000000 | round' <<<"$result")"
854	  SPENT_MICRO=$(( SPENT_MICRO + cost_micro + ledger_micro ))
855	  if [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]]; then finish interrupted 4 "driver received a signal during $label"; fi
856	  if [[ "$killed" -eq 1 ]]; then CAP_PHASE="$label"; CAP_TURN="$cap_turn"; finish cap_failure 3 "watchdog stopped $label at turn $cap_turn"; fi
857	  if [[ "$timed_out" == false ]] && { [[ $rc -eq 143 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 137 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 129 ]] || [[ $rc -eq 130 ]]; }; then
858	    finish interrupted 4 "phase $label was killed from outside (exit $rc)"
859	  fi
860	  if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
861	    if [[ "$timed_out" == true ]]; then finish agent_error 1 "phase $label timed out after ${tsec}s"; fi
862	    finish agent_error 1 "phase $label exited $rc"
863	  fi
864	  if [[ $SPENT_MICRO -ge $CAP_MICRO ]]; then
865	    CAP_PHASE="$label"; finish cap_failure 3 "spend USD $(jq -n --argjson s "$SPENT_MICRO" '$s/1000000') reached the cap USD $MAX_RUN_USD after $label"
866	  fi
867	  write_pipeline
868	}
869	
870	gate_verdict() {  # gate_verdict <feedback.md> → APPROVED | CHANGES_REQUIRED | none
871	  local f="$1" line v
872	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
873	  line="$(awk '/<!-- LOA-VERDICT \{.*\} -->[[:space:]]*$/ {l=$0} END {print l}' "$f")"
874	  [[ -n "$line" ]] || { echo none; return 0; }
875	  line="${line#*<!-- LOA-VERDICT }"; line="${line% -->*}"
876	  v="$(jq -r '.verdict // "none"' <<<"$line" 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
877	  case "$v" in APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED) echo "$v" ;; *) echo none ;; esac
878	}
879	
880	record_skip() {  # record_skip <name> <label> <reason>
881	  jq -cn --arg name "$1" --arg label "$2" --arg why "$3" \
882	    '{name: $name, label: $label, skipped: true, reason: $why, session_id: null, exit: null, cost_usd: 0}' >> "$PHASES_FILE"
883	}
884	
885	PLAN_NAMES=() PLAN_LABELS=()
886	while IFS=$'\t' read -r name label; do
887	  PLAN_NAMES+=("$name"); PLAN_LABELS+=("$label")
888	done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .label] | @tsv' <<<"$PLAN_JSON")
889	[[ ${#PLAN_NAMES[@]} -gt 0 ]] || infra "the phase plan is empty"
890	for name in "${PLAN_NAMES[@]}"; do
891	  [[ -f "$PROMPTS_DIR/$name.md" ]] || infra "no phase prompt for $name"
892	done
893	
894	write_pipeline
895	i=0
896	while [[ $i -lt ${#PLAN_NAMES[@]} ]]; do
897	  name="${PLAN_NAMES[$i]}" label="${PLAN_LABELS[$i]}"
898	  i=$((i + 1))
899	  [[ "$INTERRUPTED" -eq 1 ]] && finish interrupted 4 "driver received a signal before $label"
900	  if [[ "$name" == FIX && "$LAST_VERDICT" != CHANGES_REQUIRED ]]; then
901	    record_skip "$name" "$label" "preceding gate verdict $LAST_VERDICT"
902	    continue
903	  fi
904	  run_phase "$name" "$label"
905	done
906	
907	finish completed 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"
    65	
    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
    68	  local v
    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
    70	  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    71	  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
    72	  return 0
    73	}
    74	if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
    75	  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
    76	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
    77	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
    78	fi
    79	if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
    80	  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
    81	  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
    82	fi
    83	num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
    85	
    86	# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
    87	if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    88	  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
    89	  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
    90	fi
    91	EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
    92	if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
    93	  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
    94	  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    95	fi
    96	for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
    97	  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
    98	done
    99	if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
   100	  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
   101	else
   102	  LEDGER=""
   103	fi
   104	
   105	python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
   106	import json, sys
   107	from datetime import datetime, timezone
   108	
   109	since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
   110	runs_files = sys.argv[6:]
   111	
   112	def ts(s):
   113	    s = s.strip()
   114	    if len(s) == 10:
   115	        s += "T00:00:00Z"
   116	    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
   117	    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
   118	
   119	since = ts(since_s)
   120	skipped = 0
   121	runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
   122	seen = set()
   123	for f in runs_files:
   124	    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   125	        if not line.strip():
   126	            continue
   127	        try:
   128	            r = json.loads(line)
   129	            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
   130	        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
   131	            skipped += 1
   132	            continue
   133	        rid = r.get("run_id")
   134	        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
   135	        if key is not None and key in seen:
   136	            dedup += 1
   137	            continue
   138	        if key is not None:
   139	            seen.add(key)
   140	        runs_usd += c
   141	        runs_rows += 1
   142	
   143	ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
   144	if ledger:
   145	    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   146	        if not line.strip():
   147	            continue
   148	        try:
   149	            r = json.loads(line)
   150	            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
   151	                continue
   152	            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
   153	            ledger_rows += 1
   154	        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
   155	            skipped += 1
   156	
   157	total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
   158	headroom = cap - total
   159	if skipped:
   160	    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
   161	def n(x):
   162	    x = round(x, 4)
   163	    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
   164	if as_json:
   165	    print(json.dumps({
   166	        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
   167	        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
   168	        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
   169	        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))
   170	else:
   171	    def money(x): return f"{x:,.2f}"
   172	    def whole(x): return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else f"{x:,.2f}"
   173	    print(f"cycle spend USD {money(total)} (runs {money(runs_usd)} + ledger {money(ledger_usd)} since {since_s}); "
   174	          f"cap {whole(cap)}; headroom {money(headroom)}; reserve {whole(reserve)}")
   175	PY

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   125	}
   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)

   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):

   258	    elif sha(p) != want:

   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then

# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
#
# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
# Run:
#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
#
# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br

FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base

ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    bash \
    git \
    jq \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    python3-venv \
    grep \
    diffutils \
    coreutils \
    procps \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
    case "$arch" in \
      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
    esac && \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq

# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
    && npm cache clean --force

# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"

# bats-core at the pinned tag
RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core

# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true

# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace

ENV TZ=UTC
ENV LC_ALL=C
ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1

USER evaluser
WORKDIR /workspace

# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
    echo "All tools verified"

5	#
6	# evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh drives Loa's phases as separate CLI sessions in a
7	# sandbox repository. Here the CLI is evals/tests/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh,
8	# docker is fixtures/docker-stub.sh, and the executor runs from a temporary copy of
9	# the harness (make_harness) whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh:
10	# the shipped script sources its library by a literal path only (eval.yml trust
11	# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
12	# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
13	# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
14	# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.

FIXTURES=("${FIXTURES[@]:0:$SCREEN_TASKS}")
fi
[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
done
for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
  fi
done

SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"

[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
[[ "$SCREEN" == "true" ]] && BATCH="screen-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
case "$BATCH" in .|..) die "invalid --batch '$BATCH' (a batch is one child directory)" ;; esac   # audit r1 DISS-C-004
SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"

# est_next fallback before any actual exists: the suite's cost hint (a number,
# or a per-task-type map read at review-catch), else USD 5.0
COST_HINT="$(yq -r '(.ab.cost_hint // .cost_hint // "") | tag' "$SUITE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ "$COST_HINT" == "!!map" ]]; then
  COST_HINT="$(yq -r '(.ab.cost_hint // .cost_hint)["review-catch"] // ""' "$SUITE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
else
  COST_HINT="$(yq -r '.ab.cost_hint // .cost_hint // ""' "$SUITE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
usd_ok "${COST_HINT:-x}" || COST_HINT=5.0

# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
verify_corpus() {
  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
import hashlib, os, sys
corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
bad = []
for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
        continue
    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
}

keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
  done
  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
  return 0
}

# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
    set_state failed; exit 3
  fi
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
    local cost
    cost="$(jq -r '(.executor.total_cost_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
      ARM_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${ARM_SUM[$i]}" "$cost")"; ARM_N[$i]=$(( ${ARM_N[$i]} + 1 ))
      POOL_SUM="$(fadd "$POOL_SUM" "$cost")"; POOL_N=$((POOL_N + 1))
    fi
    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    else
      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    fi
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  else
    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
  fi
  write_status
}

log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
write_status
trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP

PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
  local i
  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
        break
      fi
    done
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
  done
  return 0
}

# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
    set_state failed; exit 3
  fi
  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
    local cost
    cost="$(jq -r '(.executor.total_cost_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
      ARM_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${ARM_SUM[$i]}" "$cost")"; ARM_N[$i]=$(( ${ARM_N[$i]} + 1 ))
      POOL_SUM="$(fadd "$POOL_SUM" "$cost")"; POOL_N=$((POOL_N + 1))
    fi
    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    else
      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
    fi
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  else
    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
  fi
  write_status
}

PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
  local i
  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"

        break
      fi
    done
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
  done
  return 0
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
   107	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
   108	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
   109	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
   110	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
   111	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
   112	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
   113	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
   114	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
   115	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
   116	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
   117	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
   118	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
   119	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
   120	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
   121	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
   122	      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
   123	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
   124	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
   125	           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
   126	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
   127	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
   128	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
   129	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
   130	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
   131	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
   132	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
   133	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
   134	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
   135	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
   136	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
   137	      // (if $ungraded then empty
   138	          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
   139	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
   140	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   141	          else
   142	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
   143	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   144	          end)
   145	      // empty
   146	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
   147	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
   148	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
   149	      exit 1
   150	    fi
   151	  done < "$VALIDATE"
   152	  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
   153	  exit 0
   154	fi
   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
   158	[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
   159	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
   160	PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
   161	[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
   162	jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
   163	[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
   164	if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
   165	  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
   166	fi
   167	[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
   168	GRADE_JSON=null
   169	if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
   170	  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
   171	  GRADE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$GRADE")" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
   172	fi
   173	MAN_JSON='{}'
   174	if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
   175	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
   176	  MAN_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST")" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
   177	fi
   178	TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
   179	PIPE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$PIPE")"
   180	RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")"
   181	
   182	# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
   183	META_ARM=""
   184	[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   185	MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' <<<"$MAN_JSON")"
   186	if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
   187	  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
   188	fi
   189	ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")}}"
   190	[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
   191	
   192	# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
   193	MINV='[]'
   194	if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   195	  MINV="$(awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
   196	          | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
   197	                         | select(.row != null)]')"
   198	fi
   199	
   200	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
   201	  local f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
   202	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
   203	  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
   204	}
   205	ENV_REVIEW="$(envelope review)"
   206	ENV_AUDIT="$(envelope audit)"
   207	
   208	# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
   209	DOT_WRITES='[]'
   210	shopt -s nullglob
   211	ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
   212	shopt -u nullglob
   213	if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   214	  DOT_WRITES="$(for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
   215	      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
   216	      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
   217	        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
   218	                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
   219	        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
   220	        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
   221	    done | jq -s -c '.')"
   222	fi
   223	
   224	ROW="$(jq -n -c \
   225	  --argjson p "$PIPE_JSON" --argjson task "$TASK_JSON" --argjson g "$GRADE_JSON" --argjson m "$MAN_JSON" \
   226	  --argjson minv "$MINV" --argjson er "$ENV_REVIEW" --argjson ea "$ENV_AUDIT" --argjson dot "$DOT_WRITES" \
   227	  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
   228	  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
   229	  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
   230	  def ms(ts): if ts == null then null else (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) end;
   231	  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
   232	      {planned: (e.verdict_quality.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
   233	       completed: (e.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
   234	       quality: (e.verdict_quality.status // e.status // null),
   235	       companion_planned: e.metadata.companion_voice.planned} end;
   236	  ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
   237	  | [ $ran[] as $ph
   238	      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
   239	      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
   240	      | $ph + {
   241	          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
   242	          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
   243	          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
   244	                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
   245	                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
   246	                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
   247	          model_mismatches: [ ($ph.models_used // {}) | keys[] | select((. | norm_model) != ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) ]
   248	        } ] as $phases
   249	  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
   250	        | .model_requested as $req
   251	        | ( .model_mismatches[] | "\($l): model \(.) used, \($req) requested" ),

   253	          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
   254	      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
   255	          | voices($e) as $v
   256	          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
   257	            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
   258	                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
   259	    ) as $why
   260	  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
   261	  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
   262	     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
   263	     else $pst end) as $status
   264	  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
   265	  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
   266	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
   267	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
   268	  | {
   269	      schema_version: 1,
   270	      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
   271	      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
   272	      arm: $arm,
   273	      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
   274	      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
   275	      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
   276	      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
   277	      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
   278	      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
   279	      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
   280	      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
   281	      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
   282	      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),

resolve_arm_toggles() {
  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
  local found=0 entry=""
  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || entry=""
    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
  fi
  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
    return 2
  fi
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
    return 2
  fi
  local t
  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
  printf '%s' "$t"
}
