head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:783 — Sandbox escape: the agent can write `.git/hooks/*`, `core.hooksPath`, `core.fsmonitor` or `filter.*` settings into the read-write `/workspace/.git`, and the host-side snapshot commands (`sgit add -A`, `commit`, `bundle` at 783-787) then run them as the operator, outside the container. `sgit` (446-449) only nulls global/system config, never repo-local config or hooks. Reproduced with a post-commit hook. Fix: pass `-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.fsmonitor=` and ignore repo config, or take the snapshot inside the container.
head/evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh:513 — `init_sandbox_beads` runs `bash "$ws/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh"` from the evaluated (possibly PR) source tree on the host, with the driver's full environment (`GH_TOKEN`, AWS/Bedrock keys). This breaks the trust boundary that pipeline-run.sh:125 and eval.yml promise ("no harness script runs .claude/ code"); the trust-boundary test only scans for `source`, not `bash <path>`.
head/evals/harness/took-effect.sh:266 — `integrity_clean` never requires the recorded `arm_evidence.manifest_sha256` to equal the sandbox `checksums.json` hash; a mismatch only drops the "(matches checksums.json)" suffix and the rule still returns 0. An agent that edits a mounted `.claude/` file and re-hashes its manifest entry, or deletes a file together with its entry, passes the integrity rule. took-effect.bats:164-173 re-hashes on purpose and hides this.
head/evals/harness/took-effect.sh:354 — The `--batch-dir` walk (`find -maxdepth 4 -name meta`) descends into `sandbox/`, so an agent-written `sandbox/meta/pipeline.json` counts as a run. It can abort the batch with exit 2 or add a forged run, which violates the "never read evidence from sandbox/" rule (DEC-0413).
head/evals/harness/took-effect.sh:139 — When `pipeline.json` is unreadable or truncated, `jq` fails and leaves the count empty; `[[ "" -eq 0 ]]` is true, so `no_plan_phase`, `no_gate_phases` (157-158) and `applicability_refused` (273-276, empty task type) report OK on missing evidence instead of failing.
head/.github/workflows/bats-tests.yml:178 — The new `gen-checksums.sh --check` gate cannot pass on this PR. The change edits about 16 tracked `.claude/` files (model-config.yaml, check-loa.sh, preflight.sh, generated-model-maps.sh, CLAUDE.loa.md, the bridgebuilder dist/resources, an adapter test) but does not regenerate or commit `.claude/checksums.json`, so `--check` reports drift, or "manifest not found" if no manifest is tracked. check-manifest-paths.bats MP-6 has the same problem. Regenerate the manifest with tools/gen-checksums.sh in this PR.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:860 — Every non-zero phase exit becomes `agent_error` (exit 1), including `docker run` failures (125: daemon down, name clash) and `timeout`/exec 126/127 (CLI missing). The header (99-100) classifies these as `infrastructure_error` (exit 2). Infra faults get charged to the arm and skew results.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:773 — The host driver reads and `cp`s agent-controlled `sandbox/.eval/*.jsonl` and `a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-*.json` (also 713, 769) without refusing symlinks. A container agent can point them at host files and have the contents copied into the grader-visible `eval/`, or at `/dev/zero` to hang `wc -l`.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:690 — In container mode all phases share one per-run HOME, so the CLI session store (`~/.claude/projects/-workspace/*.jsonl`) with the implementer's transcripts is readable by REVIEW and AUDIT. This undermines the context separation that A6 (`context_resets`) is measured against.
head/evals/harness/run-arms.sh:454 — On a transport retry the first attempt's `executor` is discarded (`executor='null'`), so its `total_cost_usd` never reaches `SPENT` (506). Trials that leave no row (killed, timed out before `executor.json`) also add $0. `--max-usd` therefore under-counts real spend and can be exceeded.
head/evals/harness/run-arms.sh:176 — When the cost hint is a map, run-arms always reads the `review-catch` key, even for `--suite audit-recall`, so the audit suite's `est_next` fallback uses the wrong task type's hint.
head/evals/harness/run-arms.sh:121 — The `--max-usd` positivity check compares the string to "0", so `0.0` / `0.00` pass validation and every trial is cut immediately. Compare numerically.
head/tools/check-manifest-paths.sh:80 — `git ls-files` runs without `-z`, so with the default `core.quotePath` any non-ASCII or quote-bearing path is C-quoted and never matches the raw key from `jq`. Such a tracked file is reported "untracked" and the gate fails. gen-checksums.sh uses `-z`, so the two tools disagree.
head/evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats:668 — The env-allowlist test is vacuous: the `! grep` lines (668-669) are mid-test and bats/`set -e` ignores negated commands. Adding `GH_TOKEN`/`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` to the passed keys still passes (reproduced).
head/evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats:610 — The "meta boundary" check `! grep -rqF "$arm" …` sits mid-loop and cannot fail; writing the arm id into the sandbox still passes (reproduced).
head/evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats:311 — In `[ ! -e .claude ] && [ ! -e CLAUDE.md ] && [ ! -e grimoires ]` only the last test is enforced, so A0 is never checked for `.claude/`/`CLAUDE.md` (reproduced). The same pattern of non-failing `&&` chains and mid-test `!` appears at 201, 202, 204, 209, 237, 294, 332, 339, 390-394, 548, 652 and 726; 157 is a tautology.
head/evals/tests/took-effect.bats:147 — `[ "$status" -eq 1 ] && line … | grep -q …` mid-test never fails, so the REVIEW==AUDIT shared-session case is never asserted.
head/evals/tests/ablation-row.bats:112 — `[ "$status" -eq 1 ] && [[ … ]]` mid-test never fails, so the status-enum, task_type-enum, degraded-without-reason and graded-without-hidden_tests validations (112, 115, 118, 140) are untested.
head/evals/tests/freeze.bats:38 — The mid-test `! grep -qv …` (and `! grep -q '  smoke/'` at 79) is ignored by bats, so the manifest-shape and smoke-exclusion checks never fail.
head/evals/tests/took-effect.bats:18 — `setup()` copies `fixtures/ablation-runs/runs`, which this PR does not add (only `regen.sh` builds it). Same at ablation-row.bats:19. On a clean checkout the new CI step "Run eval harness tests" fails in setup for every test, unless that directory is committed elsewhere.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:167 — The preflight only checks that `jq` exists, but the jq programs use `$label`, a reserved word in jq 1.6 (702/708, 816/826, 881-882; sandbox-mount.sh:462/467; ablation-row.sh:285), so they fail to compile on Debian bookworm / Ubuntu 22.04 jq 1.6 (48/52 tests fail there). Rename the variable or enforce jq >= 1.7. `python3` (needed by ENV_SHIM) is also missing from the tool check.
head/evals/harness/took-effect.sh:69 — `VAR="${2:-}"; shift 2` with a missing option value makes `shift` fail under `set -e` → exit 1, which these scripts use for "rule FAIL"/"drift", not the documented usage exit 2. The same happens in spend.sh:49, ablation-row.sh:73, freeze.sh:43, validate-suite.sh:62 and fingerprint.sh:44 (`${2:?}`).
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:595 — `price_for` is always called inside `$(...)` (718), so the `PRICE_CACHE` update happens in a subshell and is lost; pricing.py runs on every phase, contrary to the "fetched once per model" contract (91).
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:477 — Appends to `$WS/.git/info/exclude` without `mkdir -p "$WS/.git/info"`; with an init template that lacks `info/`, the driver aborts.
head/evals/tests/spend.bats:83 — SP-6 asserts only `reserve_usd == 250`, which equals the hard-coded fallback, and never asserts `cap_usd`; a broken suite lookup still passes.
head/evals/harness/spend.sh:152 — Ledger cost reads only `cost_micro_usd`; rows that carry only `cost_usd` (which pipeline-run.sh:771 accepts) and rows without a parseable `ts` count as $0 without being reported as skipped, so the cycle cap under-counts.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:83 — `exclusion.statuses` lists `degraded`, which is not one of the row statuses validated by ablation-row.sh:88 (`degraded` is a separate boolean), so the exclusion can never match.
head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:326 — `(e or {}).get` raises AttributeError for a non-object `hidden/manifest.json` entry, so a malformed fixture becomes "validator crashed" (exit 2) instead of a reported violation.
head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:368 — The message prefix is doubled ("fixture path rule: fixture path rule: …").
head/evals/harness/freeze.sh:69 — `find -type f` skips symlinked files and directories under `tasks/`, so a symlink's target can change without `--check` detecting drift.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:85 — The header says the image ships codex 0.137.0, but Dockerfile.ablation:25 pins `CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1`.
head/evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation:19 — The `brbuild` stage (`rust:1-bookworm`, unpinned) is never used, and line 77 says beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io, so non-BuildKit builds fail. The stage is dead and unreproducible.
head/evals/tests/gen-checksums.bats:9 — The header says "the live manifest is only read by GC-8", but no GC-8 exists, so nothing tests that the committed manifest matches a regeneration.
head/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml:144 — gpt-6.1-sol ships with PLACEHOLDER pricing copied from gpt-5.5 ("until the rate card is confirmed"). Cost estimates and MODELINV rows for the codex hop are priced from unconfirmed numbers; the confirmed rate should land before merge or be tracked as a blocker.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

content.text:
My review is in `/workspace/review.md`: 34 findings, verdict **CHANGES_REQUIRED**. Nothing under `pr/` was changed.

**Why it can't merge:**
- **Agent code can run on the host.** After the IMPLEMENT and FIX phases, `pipeline-run.sh:783` runs `git add`/`commit`/`bundle` on the host against the `.git` the agent can write to. Its git wrapper ignores only global and system config, so a hook or `core.fsmonitor` the agent plants runs as the operator, outside the container. One of the parallel reviewers reproduced this with a planted post-commit hook.
- **Evaluated-tree code runs with secrets.** `sandbox-mount.sh:513` runs `update-beads-state.sh` from the tree under evaluation (possibly a PR) on the host, with the driver's full environment, including `GH_TOKEN` and AWS keys.
- **The integrity check can be fooled.** `took-effect.sh:266` never checks the sandbox manifest against its recorded hash. So an agent that edits a mounted `.claude/` file and updates its manifest entry still passes `integrity_clean`. The batch walk at line 354 also counts `meta/` directories the agent creates inside `sandbox/` as runs.
- **The new CI gate will fail.** The PR changes about 16 tracked `.claude/` files but doesn't regenerate `.claude/checksums.json`, so `gen-checksums.sh --check` (`bats-tests.yml:178`) can't pass.
- **The spend cap under-counts.** `run-arms.sh` drops the cost of a retried attempt and counts $0 for trials that leave no row, so `--max-usd` can be exceeded.
- **Many new tests can't fail.** Assertions written as `! grep …` or `[ … ] && …` in the middle of a bats test are ignored. These include the env-allowlist test, A0's "no `.claude/`" check and several validation checks. Reproduced: leaking `GH_TOKEN` into the container still passes. Two test files also copy a fixtures directory (`fixtures/ablation-runs/runs`) that the PR doesn't add; this snapshot doesn't include it either, so I couldn't tell whether it's committed elsewhere.

The other findings are medium and low:
- Docker and missing-CLI failures are recorded as the agent's fault.
- The driver follows symlinks the agent creates.
- jq 1.7 is required but never checked; the scripts fail on jq 1.6, which the Docker base image ships.
- Options with a missing value exit 1 instead of the documented 2.
- `check-manifest-paths.sh` lists files without `-z`, so non-ASCII paths read as untracked.
- The new gpt-6.1-sol entry ships with placeholder pricing.
- A few docs don't match the code.

I reviewed the modified files and `run-arms.sh` myself and split the large new scripts between two parallel reviewers. I re-read the code for their main findings to confirm them. On the test runs: the pipeline and took-effect tests pass with jq 1.7.1, but 48 of 52 pipeline tests fail with the system's jq 1.6. `freeze.bats`, `validate-suite.bats` and the `tests/unit` files couldn't be run, because the files they depend on aren't in the snapshot.
